gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Controlled vocabulary for diggs:SampleType/qualityClass - ISO 22475-1:2021's five-class scale (reiterating EC7-2) for which soil properties can be relied on from a recovered sample, ranging from full retention of strength and compressibility parameters (class 1) to bare stratigraphic sequence only (class 5). A SOIL concept only - the standard does not apply quality classes to rock samples the same way (rock uses diggs:AbstractSamplingActivityType/samplingCategory directly, with no separate class layer); nothing in the schema enforces this restriction, so consult this description before assigning a qualityClass to a rock sample. PROVISIONAL: reconstructed from a named, dated trade-journal article that directly quotes EC7-2's Table 1 and ISO 22475-1 clause numbers throughout (not a search summary), cross-checked against the same article's own worked technique/category/class examples for internal consistency, but not verified cell-by-cell against the table's own grid, nor against the paywalled ISO text itself - see docs/build/R16/NOTES.md section 10 in the rigid-inclusions repo.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Sample Quality Class

diggs:Definition.gml:description: All properties considered unchanged - particle size, water content, density and permeability, and compressibility/shear strength are all reliably representative of in-situ conditions. Required wherever strength or compressibility/stiffness testing is scheduled. Achievable only with a thin-walled (open or piston) tube sampler or a triple-tube core barrel, meeting Category A.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Quality class 1

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Particle size, water content, density and permeability remain reliably representative, but the sample is too disturbed for compressibility or shear-strength testing.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Quality class 2

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Particle size and water content remain reliably representative; density- and permeability-related properties are no longer reliable.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Quality class 3

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Only particle size (broad soil type) and the sequence and broad boundaries of strata remain reliably determinable; water content is no longer reliable.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Quality class 4

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Only the sequence of layers and broad stratigraphic boundaries are determinable; no soil property is reliably representative of in-situ conditions.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Quality class 5
